note:
Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX; translators pasted verse text by script from it. A row is `mined` only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND the block contains a run of at least 45 characters (or the whole verse, if shorter) of that verse's OLCB text, quote marks aside — 90 'verbatim' claims that failed that bar (mostly short fragments) were demoted to `self_rendered`. Everything else is `self_rendered`: Murray's loose, re-personed or KJV-only wording, and his unmarked allusions. block_index is per chapter (chapter_order), split on

.

OLCB follows the critical text in places Murray (KJV) does not, and was quoted as it stands: Matthew 17:20 reads «little faith» where Murray's lesson 'The Cure of Unbelief' has 'unbelief'; Matthew 6:6 is a paraphrase with no 'which is in secret', so Murray's refrain «Saba Kitaawo ali mu kyama» is self-rendered (lesson 3).

Murray's mis-cited references are kept as printed in this edition and listed in the PR (Matt 21:20 for 22:20, 2 Tim 2:7 for 3:17, Lev 11:22 for 21:1-6, Rom 12:8 for 13:8, John 9:20 for 17:20, Luke 21:32 for 22:32, Matt 5:45 for 5:48); a source-repair pass should fix them in the English and every edition together.

I will' echo (‘KITANGE! NJAGALA’, OLCB Yokaana 17:24) and Murray's 'thy Father which is in secret'. AI-translated; awaiting native review.
